description: NY parallel drum crush. Deep pre-fader feed into a crushed FX path under the dry kit. Blend with the send level.
name: parallel-ny
notes: Precondition: FX track Parallel with compressor slot 0; Drums send slot 2 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select Parallel for calls 2-6, then select Drums for calls 7-9. Confirm with session.status before each group.
Pre-fader feed (prepost 1) keeps the crush constant while balancing the dry kit.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
